content: Ersa Nigedemu Ghuala
Falisaini nie kunyi niereni Nigedemu giene. Yutai kunlani nie lindao wo.
Ene kun xienidei Ersai ochirale ire hhende kieliewo, "Labi, chi Hudai hhense iresan loushi bikui bijien mejiene. Huda chighala hhantu wise chi giesan ghudureqini kiemada gie dane."
Ersa hhende kieliewo, "Bi chade shuhuajia kielieye, kunyi erchan
ulie oluse Hudai gojiai chanla dane."
Nigedemu kieliewo, "Kun fugiedadene pse matugie olune? Anane kielide orosenu pse olunu?"
Ersa kieliewo, "Bi chade shuhuajia kielieye, kunyi usu, Shenlinse ulie oluse Hudai gojiade oro dane.
Beyese olusanshi beye wo, ruhherse olusanshi ruhher wo.
Bi kieliese ta erchan olukuni wo giese ta bu ghudure.
Kei suibien feiliekui ta sonosu shidanema, khalase iresanyi, khala echikui ulie mejiene. Ruhherse olusan kun keighala niekielien wo."
Nigedemu asazho. "Matugie imutu shiqin wine?"
Ersa kieliewo, "Chishi Isilieni fugie loushi wo. Ene shiqinyi ulie mejienu?
Bi shuhuajia kielieye, bijien mejiesanne tande kieliezho, chujieghesanne ganzhen beizhoma, ta bijienyi kielienyi xianxin ulie giene.
Bi zemin jieredu shiqinyi kieliese ta xianxin ulie giene, asiman jieredu shiqinyi kieliese matugie xianxin giene?
Asiman jierese bouzhesan Kunnikewonse chugo kiemada asiman jiere khizhi ese daozho.
Musa hontande mogheini qila qiighaku mutun Kunnikewonniye qingiezhi qila qiighane.
Ingiese jien hhei xianxin giesan kunlade chanqiku amin ogine giezho.
Huda duyani kunlade olon orezhi lien niekozi kewonneliuzhe ogiwo. Ingiese jien hhei xianxin giesan kunlai ulie widaghazhi chanqiku amin ogine giezho.
Hhe kewonne peizhi duyade ireghase zui jinjile ese irezho, kunlai jiuighale irezho.
Hhei xianxin giesan kunlade zui ulie jinjine. Xianxin ulie giesan kunlade zui ijin jinjiwo. Hhela Hudai niekozi kewonni xianxin ese giezho.
Hhela giesan doghunnishi gon duyade irese gonde xiqi uwo, kharanide xiqi wo. Hhelai zuini jiu ingiezhi soughawo.
Doghunni giesanla gonni henjine, gon shida ulie irene. Giesanlaini khizheghakuse ayizho.
Zhendaode giesan kunla gon shida irene. Hudai isighala giesan shiqinlai man mejieghane giezho."
Yaheiya Ersani Kuaizho
Enense khuinashi Ersa tujilarene Yudayani oronde echidene nietan souzhi kunlai xili gieghazho.
Salenni kouisan Ainende usu olonshi Yaheiyaye hhende xili gieghazho. Kunla hhende xili gieghakui jienliele irezho.
Hhe shihoude Yaheiyani da bafanzide bareizhi ese echizho.
Yaheiyai tujila nie Yutai kunghala waghaku banfa jiere jianjindu qiiwo.
Hhela Yaheiya shida iredene kieliewo, "Loushi, melieshida Yedanhe hhemiende chighala hhantulasan hhe kun ede kunlade xili gieghazho. Chi hhende ganzhen beizho. Kunla man hhei shida echizho."
Yaheiya kieliewo, "Huda ulie ogise kun yama jienlie dane.
Bishi Mexiha pusho. Mii hhense melie peizhi ireghawo giezhi bi kieliezhi daosei ta mejiene.
Shini bierei agikushi shini khughon wo. Peikieni hhei kanzide beizhi shenqiini nie sonosuse hende bayasune. Biye qingiezhi hende bayasuzho.
Hhe hendakuni wo, bi bixindakuni wo."
Asiman Jierese Iresan
"Jierese iresan hhe yanseliuzhe fugie wo. Zemin jierese iresanshi zemin jieredu wo. Kieliesan kielienla yeshi zemin jieredu wo. Asiman jierese iresan hheshi yanseliuzhe fugie wo.
Hhe chujieghesanne, chenliesanne ganzhen beizhoma, hhei ganzhenyi kiema ulie jienliene.
Hhei ganzhenyi xianxin giesan kunla Hudashi zhenni enbene giezho.
Huda peizhi ireghasan hhe Hudai kielienyi kieliene. Huda hhende Shenlinni shuzi witui ogizho.
Adani kewondene orezhi man hhei khade jiuiwo.
Kewonyini xianxin giesan kunde chanqiku amin wine. Hhei ulie shunjichen kunde amin uwo. Hudai hokuku chan hhei jiere wo."
